# Avsnitt 587 - Robotarna tar över

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-06-30  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The Fill or Kill hosts discuss a quiet, pre-July-4th summer market dominated by low-ball M&A bids in beaten-down Swedish small-caps (Aino Health, Viva Wine, Sinch, Humana), a bullish long-term thesis on European satellite champion Eutelsat, an emerging humanoid-robotics theme (Agility Robotics SPAC, Hexagon, pick-and-shovel chip/actuator suppliers), and strong seasonal biotech momentum (Abcellera). Macro themes include falling oil, an Iran/US deal keeping oil dollar-denominated, and rising semiconductor/memory prices feeding inflation. Sentiment is mixed: constructive on space, biotech and robotics, but wary of thin flows, cheap opportunistic bids and speculative summer pump schemes.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ETL — Eutelsat | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Asymmetric long: European LEO champion, deeply undervalued, French/UK state and pension backing, undervalued spectrum rights not on balance sheet; heavy capex to 2030 affects all peers equally.

#### Reasoning

Host argues Eutelsat is the only credible European alternative to SpaceX/Starlink, is Iris² technical leader, and its spectrum rights (like scarce land) are mispriced and off-balance-sheet. State backing derisks capex; sector has been crushed by SpaceX-IPO flows and negative-basket hedges, creating asymmetry. Up ~35% YTD but seen as intact thesis, not a trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if France/UK withdraw state support or funding
- if Iris² program awards go elsewhere
- if dilutive emissions like SAS erode equity value
- if capex overruns without offsetting contracts

> *"Jag letar ju efter asymmetri och där tycker jag väl att asymmetrin finns i Hotelsat för att det är väldigt mycket capex för alla de här bolagen men de har ju en statlig spelare i ryggen."*

---

### 🟢 ABCL — Abcellera | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Up 132% YTD; reliable June-July biotech seasonal strength (roughly +100% each June historically); hot-flash drug data catalyst due in the fall; host-owned.

#### Reasoning

Host sees biotech entering an early-stage bull after years of post-COVID misery, driven by capital influx, less red tape, and AI raising hit-rates/lowering drug-development cost and time. Abcellera exemplifies the seasonal strength and has a fall data catalyst; hosts advise taking profits off the table to ride binary outcomes with smaller positions.

#### Sell Triggers

- if fall hot-flash trial data disappoints
- if biotech seasonal strength fades after July
- if broad biotech risk appetite reverses

> *"Absellerödan har gått i juni-juli varje år. Den gör ju typ 100% varje juni."*

---

### 🟠 HEXA-B — Hexagon | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Swedish Aeon humanoid robot getting no market credit; hosts expect US investors to discover the robotics story within 12 months.

#### Reasoning

Amid a humanoid-robotics theme kicked off by Nvidia's Groot, hosts note Hexagon's Aeon robot is overlooked domestically. They expect US investor discovery over the coming ~12 months to re-rate the name, though outcome depends on how Hexagon's robotics execution goes.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Aeon robotics program stalls or underdelivers
- if the humanoid-robotics theme cools
- if US investor interest fails to materialize

> *"jag tror att någon gång kommande tolv månaderna så kommer amerikanska investerare hitta Hexagon"*

---

### 🟠 CCXI — Agility Robotics (via SPAC) | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

SPAC CCXI/CXI merging with Agility Robotics; ran from 10 to 17 after Serenity tweeted it. Hosts want a re-entry nearer 10 as a floor into the vote.

#### Reasoning

Described as one of the few public pure-play humanoid-robot names ($2.5B, marquee customers, >$300M orders). Hosts missed the entry as it spiked to 17 on influencer buying and now watch for a pullback toward the ~10 SPAC floor ahead of the shareholder vote as a potential play.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the SPAC merger vote fails
- if it fails to pull back to an attractive entry
- if humanoid-robotics hype fades and multiples compress

> *"jag tror att det kan vara ett intressant play att titta på om den kommer ner"*

---

### ⛔ PHAL — Pharma Lundensis | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 80%

Spotlight micro-cap at 5 öre voluntarily delisting, then announced a rights issue priced at 3 SEK, sending the quote up ~2000% to 1 SEK — a summer-market pump.

#### Reasoning

Hosts explicitly warn this is a classic illiquid summer-market circus: a near-worthless stock issuing a self-serving PM about a rights issue far above the market price, triggering an irrational spike. They caution retail traders to steer clear of such distortions.

> *"Varning till alla som handlar det här. Det här känns ju helt crazy, men det är lite så det funkar på sommarbörsen."*

---

### 🟠 SINCH — Sinch | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Take-private situation; 100M SEK fine on the bid consortium; stock rose afterward; low acceptance so far, hosts speculate a higher premium may be needed.

#### Reasoning

With the consortium fined 100M SEK and having secured little acceptance, hosts think bidders may become more pot-committed and forced to sweeten the premium. Capital Group reportedly sold out cheaply, enabling the opportunistic bid; a raised offer is plausible but uncertain.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the bid is withdrawn
- if no premium increase materializes
- if consortium walks after the fine

> *"Så då är det väl lika bra att slaska upp en bättre premie."*

---

### 🟠 TXN — Texas Instruments | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Named as a conservative pick-and-shovel beneficiary of humanoid robotics; watch for dips and for signs robot-related sales are ramping.

#### Reasoning

Rather than chasing pricey pure-plays trading at 100-200x revenue, hosts favor profitable chip suppliers with robotics exposure. Advise buying on pullbacks after the semiconductor rally and, crucially, watching for actual robotics revenue to confirm production is starting.

#### Sell Triggers

- if humanoid-robotics adoption fails to scale
- if robotics-related revenue never materializes
- if semiconductor cycle rolls over

> *"du kan ju hitta lönsamma bolag som har exponering mot om det här slår"*

---

### 🟠 RRX — Regal Rexnord | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Makes motors and actuators — the 'muscles' of humanoid robots; on host's curated list of beneficiaries if robotics scales.

#### Reasoning

As a supplier of motors and actuators essential to humanoid robots, Regal Rexnord is a profitable picks-and-shovels way to gain robotics exposure. Hosts advise watching for dips and for a pickup in robotics-driven orders as the confirming signal.

#### Sell Triggers

- if humanoid-robotics demand fails to materialize
- if actuator/motor content is sourced elsewhere
- if industrial cycle weakens

> *"Regal Rex. snård RRX-tycken. De gör motorer och ställdon, vilket måste vara muskler i sådana här robotar."*

---

### 🟠 GXO — GXO Logistics | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Has a humanoid robot reportedly used by Amazon in warehouses; listed as a robotics-exposure beneficiary.

#### Reasoning

GXO's demonstrated humanoid warehouse robot (reportedly used by Amazon) gives it direct exposure to the robotics theme. Included in the hosts' list of names to watch for entry on dips and for evidence of scaling robot deployment.

#### Sell Triggers

- if warehouse-automation robotics stalls
- if the robotics program is deprioritized
- if logistics demand softens

> *"GXO Logistics. De gör ju faktiskt en humanid-robot som jag tror Amazon har använt på sina lager"*

---

### 🟠 TSLA — Tesla | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Poster-boy of humanoid robotics via Optimus, but robot progress unclear; ran on the semiconductor rally.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see Tesla as the emblematic humanoid-robotics story (Optimus) but are skeptical about actual robot progress. Worth watching as a robotics-theme proxy on pullbacks, with confirmation needed from real Optimus production/sales.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Optimus fails to reach production
- if robotics narrative deflates
- if core auto business deteriorates

> *"är det någon som har varit posterboy för den här branschen eller den här idén så är det väl Tesla"*

---
